description: This area is the heart of Mountain Biking in the Pemberton-D'arcy area. Mosquito Lake is home to 28 trails ranging from intermediate to difficult. Some of the more popular trails include Cream Puff, Mission Impossible and Meat Grinder. This area is also popular for hiking, trail running, snowshoeing and many other activities. Please share the trails!
directions: Mosquito Lake is accessible via driving though Mount Currie and taking Reid Road up to the lake. Mountain bikers can also access this area via the Gravel Pit or riding up Happy Trail.
title: Mosquito Trails
